adjudications.decision: Adopt 05-AI's evidence-gated loop as canonical over the operating memo's gateless variant
adjudications.reason: It is the only variant with a ratchet (evidence gate) and a consumption seam (preflight); the memo's variant has neither and cannot fail safe

adjudications.decision: Three tongues stand; CHILD/GRANDMA comprehension perspective is a readability TEST applied to the human tongue, not a fourth tongue
adjudications.reason: The standard's three-tongue contract is ratified and sufficient; the comprehension perspective survives as the acceptance bar 'a normal human understands why it matters'

adjudications.decision: 'NO IMPORTANT MISTAKE IS ALLOWED TO REMAIN ONLY A MISTAKE' (AI edition) and 'NO IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO DISAPPEAR WITHOUT ASKING WHAT IT CAN TEACH US' (law edition) coexist as layers
adjudications.reason: Mistake is the operational unit for machine-consumed rules; experience is the human unit; mistake is the sharpest instance of experience, so neither formulation is replaced

adjudications.decision: Founder Letter / White Paper / Operating Model / Tech Spec are document GENRES, not tongues
adjudications.reason: They name intent (why / what / how / machine-how); each genre ships in the three tongues per the standing three-language standard

questions: Can that learning improve what happens next?
compounding_standard.verdict: all six true => THE SYSTEM IS COMPOUNDING

idempotency_and_relevance.rule: stable identifiers; reprocessing never creates duplicate intelligence or recursive self-triggering loops; on conflict, stronger evidence/state wins
idempotency_and_relevance.target: RIGHT LESSON -> RIGHT MOMENT -> RIGHT ACTION

invariants.axes_never_collapsed: learning_state and evidence_state are separate fields; never substitute one for the other
invariants.no_lesson_operational_without_evidence: learning_state=OPERATIONAL requires learning_state progression through CONFIRMED and evidence_state >= TESTED (>= VERIFIED for block-capable rules)
invariants.no_second_architecture: one canonical event, one Smart Note representation, one Feed; views are projections preserving identity and lineage
invariants.privacy_gradient: PRIVATE BY DEFAULT -> SHARED BY CHOICE -> COLLECTIVE BY CONSENT -> PUBLIC BY DECISION; no private intelligence becomes collective without consent
invariants.truth_boundaries: DOCUMENTED != IMPLEMENTED != EXECUTED != OBSERVED != VERIFIED; never manufacture certainty, authority, or evidence

source_event_id.description: Mandatory lineage to the source intelligence event; a Learning Event without traceable provenance is incomplete

loop.variant_adjudication: C1: 05-AI evidence-gated loop adopted as canonical over the operating memo's gateless variant; only the former carries a ratchet (evidence gate) and a consumption seam (preflight)

not_carried_forward.customer_installation_upload_ritual: PDF-by-PDF activation unlocks and Shawn-in-the-loop gates. Adopting them as written would re-insert Shawn into a loop he explicitly ruled himself out of. Doctrine carries; ritual does not.
